Evaluation Period & Eligibility
* The performance review cycle at Relanto is half-yearly.
* Accordingly, the Appraisal cycle will also be conducted half-yearly in the months of July & January.
* The employee's probation should be confirmed with a minimum tenure of 10 months in the company at the time of
review cycle, to be eligible for appraisal.
E.g.:

sections.section_title: 1. The employee joins on January Ist, 2025, they will ideally complete their 6-month probation period by July Ist,
3. In this scenario, the employee would be eligible for a salary increment according to the company's policy as of
sections.content:
the January 2026 review cycle. This means that their eligibility for any salary increase based on the
performance ratings would be assessed during the January 2026 review cycle.
* Any employee who resigns will not be eligible for the appraisal cycle.
+ Anemployee is eligible for a promotion only after completing a minimum of 2 years with the company.
* Salary revisions for eligible employees will be synchronized with the review cycle, contingent upon the organization's
financial outlook and prevailing market conditions.
* Employees must be in good standing with the company to be eligible for performance appraisals and promotions.

sections.section_title: 1. What is the reason by review form is not getting submitted even after filling all the goals & competencies?
sections.content:
Ans: There could be multiple reasons like,
- Pending goal approvals
- Goals without subgoals/ weightages

sections.section_title: 2. Why can I not see one of my goal as part of the review form?
sections.content:
Ans: If one or more goals are not part of the review cycle, please make sure the following,
- The goals are checked for including as part of review cycle
- Goals were not added after the launch of the review cycle (June 2025)
- Goals that are pending for approval/ without weightages

sections.section_title: 3. In the manager review notification, is the displayed progress of the employee or the manager themselves?
sections.content:
Ans: The below progress is the manager's progress and not the employee's. The managers can save the progress and
revisit if any clarifications. Also, please note that ONLY after the employee successfully submitting their self review-the
form will be sent to the respective managers.

sections.section_title: 4. My review was not launched in the PMS cycle for H1 2025?
sections.content:
Ans: Please check if the below pre-requisites are met for the system eligibility,
- Minimum 4 goals set and approved with at least 1 sub-goal each
- Weightages allocated to all the set goals
- Competencies mapped to the performance module
Relanto
Reimagining Al
FAQs

sections.section_title: 5. What should | write in the comments/self-assessment sections for my goals?
sections.content:
Ans: Be specific and provide examples! Consider,
Achievements: What did you accomplish? Quantify where possible with examples (e.g., "Increased sales by 10%").
Challenges: What obstacles did you face and how did you address them?
Learnings: What did you learn? How did you develop?
Evidence (if applicable): Refer to any data, projects, or feedback and provide them as attachments.

sections.section_title: 6. What should | write in the comments for my competencies?
sections.content:
Ans: Please specify and list down the events/incidents you have demonstrated the expected behaviors of the
competencies.

sections.section_title: 7. Can | attach documents to support my self-review? How?
sections.content:
Ans: Yes, Keka usually allows attachments. Look for an "Attach File," "Upload Document," or similar button within the goal
or competency section. This is useful for providing evidence of your work or project outcomes.

sections.section_title: 8. How is my overall performance rating calculated?
sections.content:
Ans: Your RM''s rating for each goal will be added in correlation with the weightage assigned to that goal for the Goal
Score. The average RM's rating for competencies will be Competency Score.
80% of Goal Score+20% of Competency Score = Final Performance Score.

sections.section_title: 9. Who is eligible for this H1 2025 review cycle? What if I joined recently?
sections.content:
Ans: Generally, all confirmed employees who joined on or before 31st August 2024 are eligible for the appraisal process in
this review cycle. Any employees who were under maternity leave/sabbatical-request you to check with HR for eligibility.
Although all the employees who joined on or before 31st March 2025 are expected to be undergoing the performance
review process.
